> HN #4 | unkernel.dev                  
  Unkernel: Linux Kernel in Wasm        
                                        
  Unkernel compiles a genuine Linux     
  kernel directly into WebAssembly,     
  enabling native execution in the      
  browser via JavaScript to demonstrate 
  client-side system virtualization     
  without backend emulators.
